The adapter's guarded transport: it forwards a signing or sending request to the provider only after the synchronous recheck passes, so a change that lands while viem prepares the request never reaches a wallet.

Core's wallet adapter: it fetches the live connector's client and hands each call a client whose signing and sending requests recheck account, chain, Safe mode, view-as, the Center wallet and the connector uid as they are forwarded to the provider, with nothing awaited in between. A write refused before any request went out is tagged as core's 4001, so its held step is released; the wallet's own errors stay as they are.
